remarks: Beautiful and spacious Colonial 3 Bedroom 2 and a half Bathroom home for rent. The home is privately tucked away in a cul-de-sac while still offering access to the main roads. This elegant residence features high ceilings with a spacious living room that lead to an open kitchen/dining area perfect for all occasions; the half bathroom in the main level is perfect for guests. The Master bedroom located in the main level features its own private master bathroom with a gorgeous double vanity sink. The upper level features 2 bedrooms and a full bathroom connected through a mezzanine balcony that overlooks the living room. There is also a closet with extra storage space as well. Home has Washer and Dryer. Tenant pays for all utilities, Snow removal and lawn care; Renters insurance Required. No Smokers. Good Credit Required, Pets will be considered on a case by case basis. Ready for occupancy on June 1st. Schedule your showing appointment Today!!!
